name: search_bundles
description: Search product bundles owned by Only Bundles for the current shop. Returns factual bundle summaries and app links.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive bundle name search, up to 255 characters.

bundle_type.description: Optional Only Bundles bundle type filter.

status.description: Optional bundle status filter. Archived bundles are excluded when this is omitted.

limit.description: Maximum number of bundles to return. Defaults to 10.

name: get_bundle_summary
description: Get a factual summary and app configuration link for one Only Bundles bundle in the current shop.

bundle_id.description: The Only Bundles bundle ID returned by search_bundles.
